<details>
This file is a standard `.SRCINFO` metadata file for the `perl-file-raw` AUR package. It contains package description, version, dependencies, license, source URL, and checksums — all consistent with normal Arch Linux packaging practices. The source points to the official CPAN mirror for the File-Raw module (version 0.19), and checksums (md5sum and sha512) are provided rather than set to `SKIP`. There are no build functions, scripts, or executable code in this file. The packaging follows established conventions: a direct upstream source fetch, routine dependency declarations, and standard license metadata. No obfuscated code, suspicious network destinations, dangerous commands (eval, curl, wget in build context), or data-exfiltration patterns are present. The use of `http://` instead of `https://` for the CPAN source is historical and not considered a security issue per the guidelines, as fetching the upstream source over http(s) is standard practice.
</details>
